info.name: Cloudflare Workers KV Workers KV Namespace API

description.content: Cloudflare Workers KV is a globally distributed key-value store accessible via REST API. Endpoints cover namespace management, key enumeration, value reads/writes, bulk operations, bulk deletes, and key metadata retrieval. All requests are authenticated with a Bearer API token.
